limits: All350 correlated synthetic sources are reused development; synthesis labels are not verified pronunciations or new human recall.
Retained Hi ESP is P4; PocketSphinx is macOS host with a different frontend. No hardware latency, matched FAR or acoustic comparison follows.
Prime/flush/end-frame conventions differ by decoder. Return samples are observed host call boundaries, not phonetic endpoint latency.
Process peak RSS includes Python, all preloaded source PCM and native overhead. Host compute and memory are not P4 estimates.
Raw acoustic payload is about6.6MB, exceeding current2MiB filesystem even without app, decoder code or GUI assets. No drop-in firmware feasibility assumed.
No final/reserved data, training restart, playback, microphone recording, USB/board/firmware, service, original PCM speed or I2S/AEC/AGC/FIFO changes. Dining-room board excluded.
